data.one_liner: On-screen virtual keyboard widget for Flutter kiosk, POS, TV, desktop and touchscreen apps.
data.what_it_does: Renders an on-screen virtual keyboard widget inside your app instead of relying on the system keyboard. It supports standard text input, numeric keypads, PIN pads, and custom layouts in 16 languages across Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
use_when: You are building kiosk, ATM, or POS apps where the system soft keyboard is missing or blocked.
You need a custom numeric keypad, PIN pad, or OTP entry screen.
You are developing for Android TV or set-top boxes requiring D-pad remote navigation.
avoid_when: You require native system keyboard text prediction, autocorrect, or swipe typing.
You need handwriting or voice input capabilities.
strengths: Works out of the box with any standard TextField or TextFormField via standalone mode.
Supports 16 built-in languages, RTL text, and custom layouts.
Includes D-pad and remote navigation for Android TV and set-top boxes.
weaknesses: Does not support word prediction, autocorrect, or swipe typing.
data.setup_notes: Call initializeKeyboardLayouts() before runApp() to register built-in languages.
